defs.def: a single thing, person or group that is complete by itself but can also form part of sth larger 单独的事物（或人、群体）；单位；单元

ex.s: I was born and raised in Cleveland, Ohio in the United States.
ex.t: 由于配对过程涉及许多因素，并非所有报名的学生都能匹配到搭档并能够注册参与本项目。

ex.s: In 1993 the United Nations decided that March 22nd is the World Day for Water.
ex.t: 1993年，联合国决定将3月22日定为世界水日。

ex.s: A They decided on a tour to the United States in 1964.
ex.t: A 他们决定在1964年赴美巡演。

ex.s: Colonel Evans Carlson of the United States Marine3 Corps4 observed these cooperatives while he was in China.
ex.t: 美国海军陆战队3团4的埃文斯·卡尔森上校在中国期间观察了这些合作社。

ex.s: Gray wolves once were seen here and there in the Yellowstone area and much of the continental United States, but they were gradually displaced by human development.
ex.t: 灰狼曾经出现在黄石地区和美国大陆许多地方，但由于人类活动的影响，它们逐渐被驱逐。

ex.s: Wildlife research in the United States.
ex.t: 美国的野生动物研究。

ex.s: Background information In the United States, there is an Orientation Day at the beginning of the school year for new students.
ex.t: 在我们的日常生活中，问题会引发更深层次的思考和……/当你被问到……

ex.s: In the 1980s, the team burst onto the international volleyball scene with several major world titles, and an amazing three-set victory over the United States in the final of the 1984 Los Angeles Olympics.
ex.t: 20世纪80年代，这支球队突然在国际排坛崭露头角，赢得了几个重要的世界冠军，并在1984年洛杉矶奥运会决赛中以惊人的三比零战胜美国。

defs.def: a single item of the type of product that a company sells 一件（商品）；单位
a group of people who work or live together, especially for a particular purpose 班组；小队
a department, especially in a hospital, that provides a particular type of care or treatment 科；病区
a piece of furniture, especially a cupboard, that fits with and matches others of the same type 配套家具组件；（尤指）成套家具中的柜子
a fixed quantity, etc. that is used as a standard measurement 单位；单元
a small machine that has a particular purpose or is part of a larger machine 装置；机件；部件；元件

ex.s: The United States rose to global power on the strength of its technology, and the lifeblood that technology has long been electricity.
ex.t: 美国凭借其技术实力崛起为全球强国，而技术长期以来的命脉是电力。

defs.def: one of the parts into which a textbook or a series of lessons is divided 单元；课
a single flat/apartment or house in a building or group of buildings containing a number of them （一）套；单元

ex.s: Two years later, 18 years before Wyoming became a state, Yellowstone became the first national park in the United States and the world.
ex.t: 两年后，早于怀俄明建州18年，黄石成为美国和世界上第一座国家公园。

ex.s: It’s a joyful and stressful time of year in the United States for students and their families as they make decisions about where to attend college.
ex.t: 对于美国的学生和家庭来说，这是一年中既快乐又充满压力的时期，因为他们要决定去哪所大学上学。

ex.s: Florida was ruled by Spanish until the United States took over it.
ex.t: 佛罗里达一直由西班牙统治，直到美国接管了它。

ex.s: The United Nations Children’s Fund, also knowing / known as UNICEF, is a United Nations (UN) organization basing / based in New York.
ex.t: 联合国儿童基金会，也称为UNICEF，是一个总部设在纽约的联合国组织。

ex.s: Lipan Apache in the United States (two or three) or Wadjigu in Australia (one, with a question-mark): none of these seems to have much chance of survival.
ex.t: 美国的利潘阿帕奇语（两三个人）或澳大利亚的瓦吉古语（一人，带问号）：这些似乎都没有多大存活机会。

ex.s: PASS involves weekly sessions where you work in groups to tackle specially prepared problem sets, based around a unit of study you’re enrolled in.
ex.t: PASS包含每周的小组活动，你以小组形式攻克特别准备的问题集，围绕你所修的一个学习单元。

ex.s: As a new unit started, I asked everyone to write a persuasive piece on a health-related topic of their choice.
ex.t: 随着新单元开始，我让每个人就自己选择的健康相关话题写一篇说服性文章。

ex.s: Asking a favor of the President of the United States was no casual matter, especially for a seventeen-year-old girl.
ex.t: 请美国总统帮个忙绝非小事，对一个17岁的女孩来说尤其如此。

ex.s: Benjamin Franklin (1706-1790) was one of the Founding Fathers of the Fathers of the United States and helped draft the Declaration of Independence.
ex.t: 本杰明·富兰克林（1706-1790）是美国开国元勋之一，曾协助起草《独立宣言》。

ex.s: For instance, while on a lecturing tour of the United States, Twain went into a barber’ shop to get a haircut and a shave.
ex.t: 例如，有一次吐温在美国做巡回演讲时，走进一家理发店去理发和刮胡子。

ex.s: We house a broad range of experts united by the common goal of creating the best language learning tools possible.
ex.t: 我们汇聚了众多专家，他们因创造尽可能好的语言学习工具这一共同目标而团结在一起。

defs.def: any whole number from 0 to 9 个位数
